condition.instructions: Choose the primary operational condition in this log window.

criteria.healthy: Only routine informational messages and low-rate background warnings appear.
criteria.pool_timeout: Repeated errors say requests timed out while waiting for a database connection.
criteria.downstream_error: Repeated errors identify a non-database downstream service.
criteria.unrelated_noise: Warnings increased but do not identify a user-impacting failure.
